snippet.title: miniquest  ~ the tiny RPG ~ Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Introducing miniquest, the minimalist RPG in a tiny world. Coming August 13th, 2026. Demo coming early July. 

A retro fantasy quest shrunk down to mini-size! Challenging turn-based combat meets the tight pacing of an arcade game in this minimalist RPG. Become the Chosen Ones and vanquish the Dark Lord, all in the span of a couple of hours. Then do it again! And again. And again... forever?

Wishlist today on the Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4669800/miniquest
